company_information_modal_description: Information regarding your organisation is non-compliant. Updating this is mandatory as part of the electronic invoicing reform <anchor>find out all about electronic invoicing</anchor>. Enter your SIRET, we will take care of the rest.
company_information_modal_info_individua: If your account is not a business, please go to the profile editing form and change the account type to 'Individual'.
company_information_modal_review_title: ONE CLICK TO CONFIRM YOUR DATA
company_information_modal_review_descrip: Electronic invoicing becomes mandatory in France from 1 September 2026 (<anchor>find out all about electronic invoicing</anchor>). To ensure the compliance of your future invoices, please confirm your billing data by entering your SIRET number. We take care of the rest.
